The '''Zobbera system''' was located in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[zobberan hound]]s.<ref name="IA" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zobbera [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-17.<ref name="TEA" />
